preserved_aliases.note: These are the EXISTING names/indices the UI/L1 already reads. v1.2 does NOT rename, renumber or duplicate them.

host_action: copy contracts/bridge-v1.json, contracts/bridge-v1.1-delta.json AND contracts/bridge-v1.2-delta.json to the canonical .scratch/contracts path (worker sandbox is EPERM there)

meaning.AVATAR_SCREEN_X/Y/OK: The Avatar's own logical-screen 'feet' point, produced by the EXACT same pipeline as TARGET_SCREEN_X/Y: GameMapGump::GetLocationOfItem(avatarId, 256) -> Gump::GumpToScreenSpace(). AVATAR_SCREEN_OK(41) is the validity flag. These are engine-LOGICAL screen coords (the coordinate space Ultima8Bridge.gesture() consumes), NOT canvas/DOM pixels.
meaning.LOGICAL_W/LOGICAL_H: The engine's virtual (logical) render dimensions, == OSystem::getWidth()/getHeight(), i.e. the coordinate space the engine's whole mouse/gesture pipeline and gump tree use (U8 default 320x200; 640x400 with usehighres). This is what TARGET_SCREEN_*/AVATAR_SCREEN_* are expressed in.
meaning.WINDOW_W/WINDOW_H: The graphics window == the canvas BACKING-STORE size (WindowedGraphicsManager::getWindowWidth()/getWindowHeight()), in device/canvas pixels. May differ from LOGICAL_W/H (that is the whole point: logical != canvas).
meaning.GAME_DRAW_X/Y/W/H: The exact letterbox draw rect the backend scales the LOGICAL surface into, inside WINDOW_W x WINDOW_H. This is the real backend _gameDrawRect (WindowedGraphicsManager::getGameDrawRect()), the same rect SDL_UpdateRects() renders into and convertWindowToVirtual() maps through. GAME_DRAW_X/Y are its top-left in canvas pixels; GAME_DRAW_W/H its scaled size. No guessed centres.
meaning.VIEWPORT_OK: 1 iff a windowed graphics backend was reached and GAME_DRAW_W/H > 0 (i.e. WINDOW_* and GAME_DRAW_* are valid). Feature-detect with this; if 0, viewport fields are unusable on this build.
meaning.TEXT_INPUT_ACTIVE: 1 iff a text-input widget (Ultima8 EditWidget) currently holds keyboard focus in the gump tree -- i.e. the ACTUAL name prompt is accepting text. Derived by walking GetFocusChild() down from Ultima8Engine::getDesktopGump() and dynamic_cast<EditWidget*>. READY(20) is NOT sufficient: getMainActor()!=nullptr (READY==1) is also true during the intro cinematic and in stasis (STASIS==1), where no prompt is up.

state_fields.indices_unchanged: 0..38 keep their v1/v1.1/E2b meaning; all v1.2 fields are appended after FIXTURE_HP_CAP(38).

coordinate_projection.summary: TARGET_SCREEN_X/Y (32/33, v1.1) and the new AVATAR_SCREEN_X/Y (39/40) are the engine's own projection of an actor's 'feet' point into LOGICAL screen space. They are NOT canvas/DOM/pixels. The UI must map DOM->logical before sending a gesture, using the viewport fields below.
pipeline: GameMapGump::GetLocationOfItem(itemid, gx, gy, lerp_factor=256): gx=(i.x-i.y)/4 - (c.x-c.y)/4 ; gy=(i.x+i.y)/8 - i.z - ((c.x+c.y)/8 - c.z), where i = item lerped location, c = camera lerped location -> gump-local camera-centred coords.
Gump::GumpToScreenSpace(gx, gy): recursive add of (_x - _dims.left) up the parent chain -> absolute LOGICAL screen coords.

GameMapGump::onMouseDown(button, mx, my) performs exactly ParentToGump() then GumpToScreenSpace() before handing (sx,sy) to AvatarMoverProcess. Therefore AVATAR_SCREEN_*/TARGET_SCREEN_* are the same values the engine's own mouse-click path consumes == what bridge_gesture() takes.

viewport_letterbox.why: The UI historically converted DOM client coords straight to HTML canvas.width/height (e.g. 780x456 / 900x600) and treated those as engine coords. But TARGET_SCREEN_X/Y (172,126 observed) are LOGICAL (320x200 space). The canvas is a letterboxed, scaled view of the logical surface, so 1 logical unit != 1 canvas pixel.

source_cites: engines/ultima/ultima8/ultima8.cpp:508 (startupGame registers width/height default from usehighres)

canvas_letterbox.semantics: WINDOW_* = canvas backing-store size. GAME_DRAW_* = the real scaled draw rect of the logical surface inside the canvas (centred/aligned per stretch mode; aspect-preserved for U8 since gameNeedsAspectRatioCorrection() is true -> desired aspect 4/3). Sourced from the live backend, not recomputed.
backend_math: backends/graphics/windowed.h:270 convertWindowToVirtual: logicalX = ((winX - drawRect.left) * logicalW + drawRect.w/2) / drawRect.w  (y analogous)
backends/graphics/windowed.h:228 convertVirtualToWindow: winX = drawRect.left + (logicalX * drawRect.w + logicalW/2) / logicalW  (y analogous)
backends/graphics/surfacesdl/surfacesdl-graphics.cpp:3157 SDL_UpdateRects consumes _gameDrawRect as the SDL_RenderTexture viewport
backends/graphics/windowed.h:196 getGameDrawRect() -- NEW additive read-only accessor returning _gameDrawRect
canvas_letterbox.engine_access_path: dynamic_cast<ModularGraphicsBackend*>(g_system) -> getGraphicsManager() -> dynamic_cast<WindowedGraphicsManager*>(gm) -> getWindowWidth()/getWindowHeight()/getGameDrawRect(). VIEWPORT_OK=0 if any step fails (e.g. non-windowed backend).
canvas_letterbox.featuredetect: Read VIEWPORT_OK(50). ==1 -> WINDOW_*/GAME_DRAW_* valid; use them. ==0 -> the UI must fall back to a full-window assumption or decline the coordinate gesture (do NOT silently reuse canvas.width/height).

name_prompt.semantics: 1 iff an Ultima8 EditWidget (the name-entry text field) holds keyboard focus. This is the ACTUAL prompt, distinct from READY(20) which is 1 whenever getMainActor()!=nullptr (also true during the intro and in stasis).
name_prompt.derivation: Ultima8Engine::getDesktopGump() -> follow Gump::GetFocusChild() until null -> dynamic_cast<EditWidget*>. MenuGump::InitGump() creates EditWidget(0,0,'',true,6,110,40,15) and calls MakeFocus(); Gump::OnTextInput() dispatches to _focusChild.
name_prompt.note: No name SETTER is added or invented. The engine only REPORTS focus; text still flows through the real engine key/text-input path.

ui_integration_hook.status: source-defined; the ONLY safe DOM->logical mapping. Do NOT convert client coords to canvas.width/height directly.
ui_integration_hook.equivalent_manual_math: cx = (clientX - rect.left) * WINDOW_W / rect.width; cy = (clientY - rect.top) * WINDOW_H / rect.height; logicalX = round((cx - GAME_DRAW_X) * LOGICAL_W / GAME_DRAW_W); logicalY = round((cy - GAME_DRAW_Y) * LOGICAL_H / GAME_DRAW_H).
ui_integration_hook.for_avatar_targeted_gestures: Prefer AVATAR_SCREEN_X/Y (to toggle stance on the Avatar) and TARGET_SCREEN_X/Y (to attack/kick a target) directly -- they are already logical coords and need no DOM mapping.

featuredetect.text: Consumers must feature-detect v1.2 via the STATE map (presence of TEXT_INPUT_ACTIVE/VIEWPORT_OK) rather than assume it; all 0..38 fields/names/events are unchanged so a v1.1 consumer keeps working.
